title: Naag Bhoomi
desc: A dangerous criminal who traffics women terrorises a village community that ceremoniously worships a serpentine deity. Soon, an archaeologist gets caught up in the ensuing chaos.

title: Hogi Pyar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers attempt to fulfil their dying father's wish by marrying two daughters of an old enemy, intending to exact revenge.

title: Mere Sajna Saath Nibhana
desc: Kanhaiya, a poor street performer, falls in love with Chanchal, a wealthy woman. He convinces his mother to ask for her hand in marriage, but things take a turn when Chanchal's father insults her.

title: Gumnaam
desc: An aspiring director reluctantly becomes a police officer. Soon after, he starts investigating a serial murder case wherein the killer targets teenage girls.

title: Nagina
desc: Rajiv and Rajni lead a happy married life in their palatial home. However, things take a turn when Bhairon Nath informs her mother-in-law that Rajni is a shape-shifting snake.
